purpose: Teach: 存分/思いつか/おそらくは/久し振り/こんばんわ/すっごい/言い聞かせ/戸惑い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが存分に旅行を楽しまれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he knew how to enjoy a good trip.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic gaze into the middle distance. Slow pace. Voice carries the weight of memory, not sadness. Matter-of-fact delivery of something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、新しいお店を思いつかないって悩まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you remember how your father worried about not coming up with new shop ideas, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Gentle turn of phrase — she's inviting him to share rather than correcting. Slight lilt at the end, seeking his agreement. Tender familiarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはおそらくは天国でお元気だぞ
lines.en: Gran, your father is surely at peace now, up in heaven.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Voice softens on the word 'heaven' — not wistful, but accepting. Measured cadence. Speaking something he's made peace with long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご親戚と久し振りにお会いになって喜ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he was so happy when he saw the relatives after all that time, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle insistence on a shared memory. Voice rises slightly on 'wasn't he' — inviting his confirmation. Warmth without pushing. The rhythmic affection of long marriage.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「こんばんわ」と毎晩仰ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, I remember him saying 'good evening' to everyone every single night when we were young.
lines.style: Voice slows and becomes almost reverent on the greeting. Small wonder in the recollection. He's savoring this detail like a small, everyday kindness he'd nearly forgotten.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫のお祝いをすっごい喜んでくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He was so pleased when we celebrated the grandchildren's milestones, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright affirmation. Voice carries a hum of pride and pleasure. She's drawing him deeper into the warmth of these shared good memories. Conversational, intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫に「正直に」と言い聞かせるお姿、覚えてるぞ
lines.en: Gran, I can still see him telling the grandchildren to be honest, to tell the truth.
lines.style: Voice firms slightly on 'honest' — this matters, and he wants to preserve it exactly. Thoughtful pace. A small admiration threading through. He's handing something down through the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、新しい技術には戸惑いが多くおありだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He had such a hard time understanding new technology, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Light, affectionate laugh at the memory. Voice softens on 'hard time' — not mocking, but warm about his struggles. Conspiratorial, as if they're in on the joke together. Trailing warmth.
